metadata.description: Skills for sizing and mapping talent pools with LinkedIn Recruiter and Juicebox

plugins.name: talent-sourcing
plugins.description: Drive LinkedIn Recruiter and Juicebox through a browser to size and map talent pools. Carries each tool's full filter inventory, which counts are free, the validation rules that stop it reporting a silently wrong number, and a bundled Playwright MCP server configured with a persistent profile so logins survive between sessions.
